The overseas roadshows held in the US, UK, Dubai, Hong Kong and Singapore were led by Jio Platforms Managing Director and Reliance Jio Chairman Akash Ambani and Reliance Retail Ventures Limited Executive Director Isha Ambani.
One of the event vendors said that JPL is expected to hold a roadshow for the IPO in India in the week starting October 12 after filing the red herring prospectus.
According to banking sources, Jio Platforms is expected to start an anchor round before Dussehra and the issue is expected to open post-Dussehra before October 23.

"The company is expected to list on the stock exchange by the end of this month," the source said.
The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) issued its final observations on August 28. Jio Platforms had filed its draft IPO papers in June.
According to its draft prospectus, the company plans to issue up to 27 crore fresh equity shares, equivalent to about 2.9 per cent of its post-issue equity base.
Sources have indicated that the company may raise around $3.8 billion from the offer.
The public offering comes as India's primary market has remained active, with strong participation from retail investors and domestic institutions.

More than two dozen IPOs have been announced or launched since July 1, nearly matching the 28 recorded in the first half of 2026.
Jio Platforms houses Reliance's digital businesses, including its telecommunications operations.
Reliance Jio Infocomm, the telecom arm of JPL, dominates the Indian telecom market with a 32.89 per cent market share in fixed-line connections, serving 157.9 million customers, and a 39.29 per cent share in mobile connections, with 506 million customers.
JPL has the largest 5G Standalone network outside China, with 26.85 crore 5G customers as of June 2026. Jio leads the Fixed Wireless Access segment globally with about 1.5 crore subscribers, roughly 1.5 times the second-largest player, US-based T-Mobile.

Jio claims that its 5G network's carrying capacity is close to 60 per cent of India's wireless data traffic, one of the largest in the world.
Leveraging its network and data traffic capacity, Jio has expanded its business into other areas of the digital ecosystem, including cloud, artificial intelligence and enterprise network services.
For FY26, Jio Platforms posted a 15 per cent rise in profit after tax to ₹30,053 crore and a 14.5 per cent increase in the annual revenue to ₹1,46,885 crore.
Analysts at Nuvama Research expect Reliance Jio's profit after tax to clock a compounded annual growth rate of 18 per cent between FY26 and FY30, at par with the oil and gas vertical of parent firm Reliance Industries Limited.

Jio Platforms has previously drawn major global technology and financial investors - in 2020, Meta invested ₹43,574 crore for a 9.99 per cent stake, while Google invested ₹33,737 crore for a 7.73 per cent holding.
Other investors, including Silver Lake, Vista Equity Partners, General Atlantic, KKR, Mubadala, Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, TPG, L Catterton, Intel Capital and Qualcomm Ventures collectively invested about ₹74,745 crore for roughly a 15.2 per cent stake.
Reliance Industries owns about 66.4 per cent of Jio Platforms, and Meta and Google together hold about 17.7 per cent, according to the draft prospectus.
The IPO would be the first public offering from the Reliance group since 2008 and the first IPO of a consumer-focused business within the conglomerate.

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.title: Panthers place WR Xavier Legette on IR
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Carolina Panthers placed wide receiver Xavier Legette on injured reserve Saturday due to a knee injury.
items.body:
The Carolina Panthers placed wide receiver Xavier Legette on injured reserve Saturday due to a knee injury.
He is set to miss at least the next four weeks.
In Week 2, the 25-year-old reeled in a 55-yard reception against the Atlanta Falcons but sustained a knee injury on the play. He sat out of the team's Week 3 loss to the Cleveland Browns.
Legette was a first-round pick in the 2024 NFL Draft. Across his first two seasons, he recorded 924 yards and seven touchdowns in 33 games (25 starts).
The Panthers' receiving group could look thin on Sunday against the Detroit Lions. Leading receiver Jalen Coker (quadriceps) is listed as questionable.
On Saturday, the team also promoted wide receiver Ja'seem Reed from the practice squad. Reed went undrafted in 2025 out of San Diego and is in line to potentially make his NFL debut.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Britain scraps heavily criticised plans to curb jury trials after backlash
items.author: Sam Tobin
items.creator: Sam Tobin
items.summary: Britain will scrap plans to remove the historic right to trial by jury for defendants in less serious criminal cases, the government announced on Sunday, in response to sustained criticism of the proposals by many lawyers and politicians.
items.body:
Britain will scrap plans to remove the historic right to trial by jury for defendants in less serious criminal cases, the government announced on Sunday, in response to sustained criticism of the proposals by many lawyers and politicians.
The decision by Andy Burnham, who became prime minister in July, to drop his predecessor Keir Starmer's policy comes as hundreds of prisoners were released early to stop prisons becoming full, in just one element of a criminal justice crisis.
Plans to [USN:L8N3X80VW TEXT:"curb jury trials"] for cases where a jail sentence was likely to be less than three years would be abandoned, the Ministry of Justice said, which was broadly welcomed by the Criminal Bar Association and other groups.
But lawyers raised concerns over the MoJ's decision to increase sentencing powers for magistrates – who hear trials for more minor offences without a jury – and the removal of defendants' right to elect trial by jury.
"I have heard the strength of feeling on the proposals for increasing the number of judge-alone trials in the Crown Court and have made the decision to change course," Justice Secretary Alex Norris said.
CBA chair Andrew Thomas thanked the government for "listening to the evidence and reaching the right verdict", though he said "a severe threat to our trial by jury remains".
The Bar Council's chair Kirsty Brimelow agreed, saying that giving magistrates greater powers when the backlog in magistrates' courts is increasing could be counterproductive.
VICTIMS WAITING YEARS FOR JUSTICE The current backlog of [USN:L8N3T512N TEXT:"cases awaiting trial"] by jury in Crown Courts in England and Wales was nearly 81,000 at the end of June, almost double the figure in 2020, and victims, defendants and witnesses often wait years for cases to come to trial.
Starmer's justice minister David Lammy last year said reducing jury trials would speed up justice, but met a furious backlash from lawyers who said it curtailed the fundamental right of defendants to be tried by a jury of their peers.
Critics also argued that years of neglect and under-investment by successive governments, rather than jury trials, were the root cause of delays, while the head of England's judiciary raised "grave security concerns" for judges.
The MoJ said it would maintain plans that complex fraud trials could be heard by a judge alone, which has long been mooted to avoid jurors sitting on months-long cases, though a government-commissioned review this year rejected the idea.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US President Donald Trump has appointed Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton as the administration's AI czar, the Wall Street Journal reported on Saturday, citing an interview with Clayton.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump has appointed Director of National Intelligence [USN:L1N4400P3 TEXT:"Jay Clayton"] as the administration's AI czar, the Wall Street Journal reported on Saturday, citing an interview with Clayton.
Clayton, who was [USN:L1N4400P3 TEXT:"appointed"] intelligence chief in August, will lead a new White House panel tasked with reporting within 120 days on the risks and opportunities posed by AI, the newspaper said.
"The president asked that a group be put together," which the administration refers to as the "Super Intelligence Force," to ensure the US remains a leader in advanced AI while protecting Americans' interests, Clayton told the Journal, adding that "the risk of not being first is high."
The safety of AI has become a major issue in recent weeks, with some researchers warning that people building the technology believe it could [USN:L4N45616J TEXT:"kill humans within a decade."] Several Democratic and Republican lawmakers have responded with alarm and calls for more action.
Trump has appeared to take a [USN:FWN45G0T8 TEXT:"light touch"] toward AI regulation, arguing that excessive oversight could weaken competitiveness against China. He said on Tuesday that he [USN:RTV7Cd7Qt TEXT:"does not want to work"] with Chinese President Xi Jinping on governing AI technology.
Clayton's panel will review AI-related risks and current government reporting mechanisms for breaches, hacks and other incidents, and recommend ways to strengthen federal-response capabilities under existing authorities, the Journal said, citing the task force's charter.
This is the second time Trump has named an adviser to oversee AI-related decisions across the administration. Venture capitalist David Sacks held the AI czar role at the beginning of Trump's second term.
The task force's vice chairs will be Emil Michael, Scott Kupor and Federal Trade Commission Chair Andrew Ferguson, while members will include Vice President JD Vance, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, Treasury Secretary [USN:L6N45H0WJ TEXT:"Scott Bessent"] and White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles, according to the report. External advisers will also include Sacks and former Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice, the Journal said.

items.title: Yemen's armed forces say it is conducting strikes against Houthis in Sanaa
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Yemen's armed forces said early on Sunday it was conducting strikes against the Iran-aligned Houthis in the capital Sanaa and the group's stronghold Saada.
items.body:
Yemen's armed forces said early on Sunday it was conducting strikes against the Iran-aligned Houthis in the capital Sanaa and the group's stronghold Saada.
A spokesperson for Yemen's armed forces, which are aligned with the internationally recognised government, said forces were targeting what he described as "vital targets", without providing further details.
Yemen's Houthi-run Al Masirah TV reported earlier an attack it said was carried out by Saudi Arabia on Sanaa. There was no immediate Saudi confirmation on the report.
The conflict between the Iran-backed Houthis and forces aligned with the Saudi-backed government mostly stopped after a 2022 truce, but fighting has broken out again in a spillover from the wider war between Iran and the United States.
Hostilities resumed this year after the Houthis declared a [USN:S8N42G00S TEXT:"naval blockade"] on Saudi Arabia in July and began attacking Saudi [USN:S8N43J02R TEXT:"territory"] and shipping, while Houthi forces also made major territorial gains along Yemen's Red Sea coast.
Saudi Arabia has responded with air strikes in Yemen and backed government forces fighting to repel the Houthis.

items.title: 北朝鮮、3日に中距離ミサイル発射　極超音速兵器の部隊訓練と国営通信
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ４日 ロイター] - 北朝鮮は３日、中距離ミサイルの発射実験を行った。国営の朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）が４日報じた。金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記が立ち会ったという

ＫＣＮＡによると、東部から発射したミサイルは１０００キロ離れた日本海上の目標に命中した。訓練は、極超音速戦略兵器システムを運用する部隊の練度を高めるとともに、戦争抑止力の信頼性や効率性、機動性を検証することが目的だったとしている。

日韓の防衛当局は３日、北朝鮮が弾道ミサイルを発射したと発表していた。金総書記の妹で朝鮮労働党の金与正総務部長がその後、ミサイルの発射について声明を出していた。

与正氏は、韓国と日本がミサイルを追跡できなかったと主張。変則的に飛行する「波状軌道」を採用したことで、両国の追跡能力の限界が露呈したとした。

韓国は飛行距離７００キロ程度、日本は６８０キロ程度と分析している。

北朝鮮が弾道ミサイルを発射したのは９月２０日以来。今回は、非武装地帯（ＤＭＺ）で発生した地雷の爆発を巡って韓国と非難の応酬を続ける中で実施した。

韓国は、北朝鮮の地雷で自国の兵士が重傷を負ったと主張。与正氏は２日、韓国側の非難を「根拠がない」として一蹴し、韓国側の謝罪要求も退けた。

items.title: ウクライナ、ロシア製油所攻撃を強化へ　「新ドクトリンに対抗」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Daniel Flynn　Olena Harmash

［キーウ　３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Daniel Flynn　Olena Harmash

［キーウ　３日　ロイター］ - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシアがキーウなどの都市から住民を退去させることを狙った新たな空爆方針を打ち出したとして、対抗措置としてロシアの製油所への攻撃を強化すると述べた。ただ、民間人は標的にしないと強調した。ロイターのインタビューで語った。

ゼレンスキー氏によると、ウクライナの情報機関は、ロシアのプーチン大統領が冬を前に、これまでよりはるかに広範な民間施設への軍事攻撃を認める「新たなドクトリン」を示した文書を入手した。

ゼレンスキー氏は「われわれは文書を確認しており、インフラや物流施設、特に都市や村、あらゆる場所の道路、学校、病院への攻撃を認めていることを把握している」と説明。「首都や各地の都市から立ち去るよう住民に圧力をかける。これが作戦の目的だ」と述べた。

背景には、前線の重要地域でロシア軍が支配地を失い、死傷者も増える中、プーチン氏が強さを誇示したいと考えていることがあると指摘した。

ロシア大統領府のコメントは得られていない。一方、ロシア外務省は、外国人にキーウからの退去を促す声明で、ここ数カ月のウクライナによる対ロシア攻撃への報復として、今後も組織的な攻撃を続けると表明した。

items.title: US urges Ethiopia, Eritrea to show restraint
items.summary: The United States urged Ethiopia and Eritrea to exercise maximum restraint amid rising cross-border tensions, warning that a new military conflict could trigger a severe humanitarian crisis across the ...
items.body:
US urges Ethiopia, Eritrea to show restraint The United States urged Ethiopia and Eritrea to exercise maximum restraint amid rising cross-border tensions, warning that a new military conflict could trigger a severe humanitarian crisis across the Horn of Africa and jeopardise ongoing bilateral cooperation.
ANI | Updated: 04-10-2026 10:59 IST | Created: 04-10-2026 10:59 IST

The seal of the United States Department of State is seen in Washington, US. (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Amid escalating cross-border frictions between Ethiopia and Eritrea, the United States urged both nations Saturday to exercise “maximum restraint”, cautioning that any fresh hostilities risk precipitating an unprecedented humanitarian catastrophe across the Horn of Africa. In an official release, the State Department stressed that the worsening discord carries wide-ranging regional ramifications. State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott remarked, “Increasing cross-border tensions between Ethiopia and Eritrea have the potential to affect the entire region.”
Emphasising the fragility of the area, Pigott added, “The Horn of Africa cannot sustain another military conflict and humanitarian crisis. A conflict jeopardises ongoing US collaboration on shared interests with both countries.” Washington further appealed to Addis Ababa and Asmara to uphold international norms concerning territorial sovereignty while abandoning any escalatory measures. Stressing the necessity for diplomatic channels, Pigott stated, “We strongly urge Ethiopia and Eritrea to respect the sovereignty and territorial integrity of their neighbors, exercise maximum restraint and return to dialogue and cooperation as agreed in their 2018 peace framework.” He concluded by noting that “Peace through dialogue is the only path toward sustainable security, economic growth, and prosperity.”
This diplomatic intervention arrives as security conditions within northern Ethiopia deteriorate alongside sliding bilateral relations. Rather than introducing punitive actions or sanctions, the recent US advisory prioritised de-escalation, pointing back to the 2018 accord that resolved their historical hostilities. Tensions have mounted following renewed hostilities in Ethiopia's northern Tigray zone. Consequently, official US travel advisories currently instruct citizens to avoid travel to the Tigray region and the Eritrean border due to ongoing armed conflict and volatility.
Diplomatic relations between the two neighbours have experienced severe instability over the past three decades. Following a prolonged struggle for independence, Eritrea formally separated from Ethiopia in 1993, which later culminated in a destructive border war spanning from 1998 to 2000 that claimed tens of thousands of lives. Ties remained strained until a historic rapprochement in 2018, when Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed and Eritrean President Isaias Afwerki successfully restored bilateral relations. (ANI)

items.title: San Lorenzo cae goleado ante Defensa y Justicia en liga argentina
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: San Lorenzo de Almagro, uno de los clubes más populares del fútbol argentino, cayó goleado el sábado 3-0 en su visita a Defensa y Justicia en la undécima fecha del Torneo Clausura.
items.body:
San Lorenzo de Almagro, uno de los clubes más populares del fútbol argentino, cayó goleado el sábado 3-0 en su visita a Defensa y Justicia en la undécima fecha del Torneo Clausura.
Con la derrota, San Lorenzo se ubicó en el décimo puesto de la Zona A con 11 puntos, producto de tres victorias, dos empates y seis derrotas, por lo cual se encuentra fuera de los puestos de clasificación a la postemporada.
"Hay que demostrar la capacidad para salir de este momento. Hay que aceptar la realidad y después saber cambiarla", dijo el técnico de San Lorenzo, Rubén Insúa, en rueda de prensa.
En el partido disputado en el estadio Norberto Tomaghello, el conjunto local sacó ventaja en el primer tiempo con goles de Jeremías Lucco, David Martínez y David Barbona.
"La figura fuimos todos, veníamos de un empate sobre la hora y había que revertir en casa. Las que tuvimos las pudimos meter y en el segundo tiempo fue cuidar el resultado, Hay que seguir así, vamos bien", indicó Lucco tras la goleada.
Defensa llegó a 21 puntos y trepó al segundo puesto de la tabla de posiciones de la Zona A, a cuatro unidades de diferencia con el líder Instituto de Córdoba.
En otros partidos del sábado, Barracas Central sacó una victoria agónica 3-2 como visitante frente a Atlético Tucumán, mientras que Newell's Old Boys y Lanús igualaron sin goles.
El viernes, Boca Juniors goleó 3-0 a Unión de Santa Fe e Instituto de Córdoba venció 4-1 a Independiente de Avellaneda, mientras que Independiente Rivadavia y Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata igualaron 1-1.

items.summary: The administration made no public announcements regarding the gathering, which transpired as negotiations with Tehran remained deadlocked.
items.body:
Trump team discusses Iran war, Yemen situation in Camp David huddle: Report  The administration made no public announcements regarding the gathering, which transpired as negotiations with Tehran remained deadlocked.
ANI | Updated: 04-10-2026 10:53 IST | Created: 04-10-2026 10:53 IST

US President Donald Trump (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

US President Donald Trump’s top national security aides held an unpublicised meeting at Camp David on Friday, conferring for several hours to discuss next steps in the war with Iran alongside the Saudi-backed campaign targeting Houthi rebels in Yemen, Axios reported, citing three US officials. The administration made no public announcements regarding the gathering, which transpired as negotiations with Tehran remained deadlocked. Trump Administration is weighing whether to re-engage in major combat operations against the Iran.
Vice President JD Vance presided over the discussions. He was joined by Secretary of State Marco Rubio, US War Secretary Peter Hegseth, White House envoy Steve Witkoff, CIA Director John Ratcliffe, and Joint Chiefs of Staff Chairman Gen Dan Caine and other senior officials. Commenting on the deliberations regarding the Middle East crisis, a US official noted that critical matters were determined or evaluated. The White House declined to issue a statement concerning the gathering.
The high-level session unfolded as President Trump approaches a decisive juncture regarding the trajectory of the American campaign against Iran. “Now I have to make a decision: either Iran signs the deal, or it won’t exist any longer,” President Donald Trump had said on Thursday. When pressed by reporters on Friday afternoon regarding his prospective strategy while his advisers were holding discussions at Camp David, President Trump remarked, “If I told you, you would have a major story,” before adding, “But you will see. It is working out very well. Iran is not doing well.”
Beyond the Iranian dossier, the Camp David talks also addressed the escalating Saudi-backed push against Houthi forces in Yemen. Riyadh is reportedly preparing a prospective offensive against the Houthis, actively lobbying Washington to provide air support through US airstrikes. Although President Trump has hitherto shown reluctance to participate in the operation, American officials indicated that his stance remains subject to change. Such high-level strategy sessions at Camp David remain a rarity, with the most recent comparable meeting occurring in June 2025 shortly before the outbreak of war between Israel and Iran. (ANI)

items.title: North Korea says Kim oversaw hypersonic missile drill
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: North Korea said on Sunday it had tested a hypersonic missile under the supervision of leader Kim Jong Un, in a drill aimed at demonstrating the reliability of its nuclear deterrent.
items.body:
North Korea said on Sunday it had tested a hypersonic missile under the supervision of leader Kim Jong Un, in a drill aimed at demonstrating the reliability of its nuclear deterrent.
State media KCNA said the intermediate-range strategic missile, which it described as part of a hypersonic strategic weapon system, was launched on Saturday from eastern North Korea and struck a target about 1,000 km (621 miles) away in waters off the country's east coast.
The drill was aimed at training missile troops and assessing the efficiency and mobility of North Korea's deterrent forces, the report said.
KCNA quoted Kim as saying North Korea must continue efforts to make its adversaries recognise the "reliability and fatality" of its strategic offensive weapons, calling such activities a form of deterrence.
He also reaffirmed that developing the country's nuclear war deterrent remained indispensable for national security and that there would be no change in that policy, KCNA said.
The launch was the latest in a series of North Korean weapons tests this year and came as tensions on the Korean peninsula escalated over a landmine blast in the Demilitarized Zone last month that wounded South Korean soldiers.
TRACKING DISPUTE The KCNA report provided additional details about the missile launch [USN:L1N45P02K TEXT:"disclosed"] on Saturday by Kim Yo Jong, the sister of Kim Jong Un and a senior official in the ruling Workers' Party.
Kim Yo Jong said South Korea and Japan had failed to track the weapon's flight, saying a special "wave-like trajectory mode" had exposed limitations in their tracking capabilities.
However, South Korea's Defence Ministry said on Sunday that its military had closely monitored preparations for the launch, detected and tracked the missile immediately after liftoff and accurately identified the launch site.
The ministry also said North Korea's recently launched missiles were assessed to be within the capabilities of South Korean and US missile-defence assets to detect and intercept.
South Korea's military said on Saturday it had assessed the missile flew more than 700 km toward the sea off its eastern coast.
KCNA released unusually detailed information about the test, including precise impact coordinates.
Hong Min, a senior researcher at the Korea Institute for National Unification, said the disclosure appeared aimed at supporting North Korea's claim that the missile flew about 1,000 km and highlighting what Pyongyang sees as shortcomings in South Korean and Japanese tracking.
The missile appeared to be a cone-shaped hypersonic system first tested in 2022, he said, suggesting North Korea was signalling a shift from testing toward operational deployment.
Kim Yo Jong on Friday issued a sharply worded statement [USN:L1N45O07Z TEXT:"rejecting"] Seoul's demand for an apology over the DMZ landmine blast, saying its claims were "groundless" and that North Korea had not deliberately laid mines targeting South Korean troops.
North Korea has carried out more than 10 missile tests this year.

items.body:
O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) e o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) estão em empate técnico nos votos válidos do primeiro turno, com vantagem numérica de 3 pontos para o petista, mostrou pesquisa Datafolha neste sábado.
Lula tem 45% dos votos válidos, quando são excluídos os brancos, nulos e indecisos, enquanto Flávio soma 42%. A margem de erro da pesquisa é de 2 pontos percentuais, para mais ou para menos.
Para vencer no primeiro turno no domingo, um candidato precisa ter mais de 50% dos votos válidos.
Nos chamados votos totais, o presidente aparece com 42%, contra 40% do senador de oposição. Os indecisos somam 3% (eram 2% na pesquisa anterior), enquanto aqueles que dizem que votarão em branco, anularão o voto ou não votarão em nenhum candidato chegam a 4% (eram 5%).
Já num eventual segundo turno entre os dois, Lula registra 47% das intenções de voto (eram 48%), contra 46% de Flávio Bolsonaro (eram 45%).

items.summary: Petroecuador declaró fuerza mayor en una estación de bombeo del oleoducto SOTE tras un incendio ocurrido el 1 de octubre y desplegó un operativo para restablecer el bombeo de crudo, dijo el sábado la estatal petrolera.
items.body:
Petroecuador declaró fuerza mayor en una estación de bombeo del oleoducto SOTE tras un incendio ocurrido el 1 de octubre y desplegó un operativo para restablecer el bombeo de crudo, dijo el sábado la estatal petrolera.
La compañía explicó en un comunicado que el incendio se registró en la estación de Bombeo número del Sistema de Oleoducto Transecuatoriano, SOTE.
"Los equipos técnicos de EP Petroecuador trabajan de manera ininterrumpida en la infraestructura afectada para restablecer el bombeo de crudo por el SOTE dentro de los próximos seis días", dijo la empresa.
Petroecuador agregó que especialistas de una unidad de delitos hidrocarburíferos realiza las respectivas investigaciones.
La producción de Petroecuador al 2 de octubre se ubicó en 360.542 bppd (barriles promedio por día), según datos de la estatal.

items.title: UAE beat Oman to reach Gulf Cup final against Saudi
items.author: Mohamed Yossry
items.creator: Mohamed Yossry
items.summary: Forward Ousmane Camara scored the only goal as the United Arab Emirates beat Oman 1-0 on Saturday to set up a final against Saudi Arabia in the Gulf Cup.
items.body:
Forward Ousmane Camara scored the only goal as the United Arab Emirates beat Oman 1-0 on Saturday to set up a final against Saudi Arabia in the Gulf Cup.
Saudi edged Asian champions Qatar 3-2 on penalties after 120 minutes ended goalless in an earlier, poor-quality semi-final.
Camara headed home from close range to lead Zlatko Dalic's side to the final for the first time since 2018. The UAE are seeking to clinch the title for a third time after their triumphs in 2007 and 2013.
UAE playmaker Nicolas Gimenez squandered a penalty in the 56th minute.
"After we missed the penalty, of course we changed three players. We put in new guys, they brought something new to the team and the game, more energy, and changed the rhythm," Dalic told Abu Dhabi Sports TV.
"But we never gave up. I told my players, we worked hard for the last 20 days for what? For this night, for this game," the former Croatia coach added.
Oman, runners-up in the previous edition, had reached the semi-finals after advancing ahead of Iraq by lot when the two teams finished level on all Group A tiebreak criteria.
HEROIC AL OWAIS Saudi goalkeeper Mohammed Al Owais played a huge role by making two saves in the penalty shootout, denying Jassem Gaber and Boualem Khoukhi from the spot.
Al Owais, 34, saved Khoukhi's penalty and then denied him again when the kick was ordered to be retaken.
Qatar were solid in defence and came closest to breaking the deadlock when substitute Edmilson struck the crossbar late in the second half.
However, the main talking point for Julen Lopetegui's side was talisman Akram Afif's frustrated reaction after being substituted in the 69th minute, with the forward appearing unhappy as he left the pitch.
Saudi Arabia will hope to end a 22-year wait to regain the Gulf Cup when they host the UAE in Tuesday's final at King Abdullah Sports City Stadium.

items.title: Seahawks place RB Jadarian Price (chest) on injured reserve
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Seattle Seahawks placed rookie running back Jadarian Price on injured reserve Saturday with a chest injury.
items.body:
The Seattle Seahawks placed rookie running back Jadarian Price on injured reserve Saturday with a chest injury.
Price had already been ruled out for Sunday's home game against the Los Angeles Chargers; now, he will miss at least the next four games.
Price, a first-round selection by the Seahawks out of Notre Dame in this year's draft, suffered the injury in Week 2 against the Arizona Cardinals. Seattle coach Mike Macdonald said this week that Price aggravated the injury during practice Wednesday.
Price had 28 carries for 119 yards across his first three games. He also caught four passes for 21 yards.
Emanuel Wilson and George Holani will step into larger roles with Price out. Wilson leads the team with 32 carries, and his 109 rushing yards trail only Price. Holani leads Seattle's running backs with six receptions and 50 receiving yards.
Zach Charbonnet, who is recovering from an ACL tear, will be eligible to return in Week 5. Last season, he rushed for 730 yards and 12 touchdowns.
--Field Level Media

items.title: LE POINT sur les élections au Brésil
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Quelque 160 millions d'électeurs brésiliens sont appelés aux urnes dimanche à l'occasion du premier tour de l'élection présidentielle, un scrutin décisif pour le plus grand pays d'Amérique du Sud qui déterminera s'il emprunte à son tour le virage ultra-conservateur observé sur le continent.
items.body:
Quelque 160 millions d'électeurs brésiliens sont appelés aux urnes dimanche à l'occasion du premier tour de l'élection présidentielle, un scrutin décisif pour le plus grand pays d'Amérique du Sud qui déterminera s'il emprunte à son tour le virage ultra-conservateur observé sur le continent.
Selon les sondages, le président sortant de gauche Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, qui brigue à 80 ans un quatrième mandat non consécutif, est au coude-à-coude avec le sénateur de droite Flavio Bolsonaro, 45 ans, fils de l'ex-président Jair Bolsonaro condamné à 27 ans de prison pour tentative de coup d'Etat.
Treize candidats au total sont en lice pour accéder au palais du Planalto, dans un scrutin où le vote est obligatoire pour les Brésiliens âgés de 18 à 70 ans. Un second tour sera organisé le 25 octobre si aucun candidat n'emporte la majorité absolue dimanche.
Outre l'élection présidentielle se tiennent également les 4 et 25 octobre les élections parlementaires visant à renouveler les 513 sièges de la Chambre des députés et un tiers des 81 sièges du Sénat composant le Congrès national.
Les électeurs doivent également désigner les gouverneurs des 26 États fédérés et renouveler les assemblées législatives de ces derniers.
Voici les principaux développements et éléments à savoir:
* Brésil-Lula et Flavio Bolsonaro clôturent leurs campagnes avant le premier tour des élections [USN:L6N45P07U]
* AVANT-PAPIER-Brésil-Lula et Bolsonaro au coude-à-coude pour la présidence [USN:L6N45N0MU]
* PORTRAIT-Brésil-Flavio Bolsonaro, la présidentielle en héritage [USN:L6N45L0NC]
* PORTRAIT-Lula porte les espoirs de la gauche, au-delà du Brésil [USN:L8N45L137]
* ENCADRÉ-Brésil-Dans la course à la présidence, les écueils budgétaires sont passés sous silence [USN:L6N45L0SH]

items.title: Brésil Lula et Flavio Bolsonaro clôturent leurs campagnes avant le premier tour des élections
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Le président brésilien Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva et le sénateur Flávio Bolsonaro ont clôturé samedi leur campagne en vue du premier tour de l'élection présidentielle de dimanche, chacun se déclarant confiant quant à sa victoire malgré des sondages laissant entrevoir un probable second tour.
items.body:
Le président brésilien Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva et le sénateur Flávio Bolsonaro ont clôturé samedi leur campagne en vue du premier tour de l'élection présidentielle de dimanche, chacun se déclarant confiant quant à sa victoire malgré des sondages laissant entrevoir un probable second tour.
Lula a clôturé sa campagne de réélection par un défilé à São Paulo qui a rassemblé une importante foule de partisans, tandis que Flavio Bolsonaro a participé à un cortège de motos à travers Santa Bárbara d'Oeste et Americana, dans l'État de São Paulo, avant de tenir un meeting à Rio de Janeiro.
Le camp de Lula a décrit le dernier rassemblement de la campagne du premier tour comme une mobilisation record, supérieure à celle du meeting de clôture lors de l'élection de 2022.
Selon les organisateurs, quelque 150.000 partisans du candidat de gauche ont arpenté les deux kilomètres de la rue Augusta, entre l'avenue Paulista et la place Roosevelt, lieu traditionnel des manifestations politiques dans la plus grande ville du Brésil.
S'exprimant depuis un véhicule, Lula a qualifié l'élection de dimanche de choix entre "la démocratie et la barbarie".
Le chef du Parti des travailleurs (PT) Edinho Silva, a vu dans cette affluence un élan croissant en faveur de Lula.
"Contrairement à d'autres pays d'Amérique latine, où l'on a assisté à une vague de droite ces derniers temps, ici au Brésil, nous assistons à une vague en notre faveur", a-t-il dit.
Le sénateur de droite Flavio Bolsonaro a exhorté ses partisans à se rendre aux urnes et a prédit une victoire dès le premier tour.
"Je suis convaincu que tout est en place pour que nous remportions cette élection dès le premier tour", a-t-il dit.
Flavio Bolsonaro a été photographié tenant une pancarte à l'effigie de son père, l'ancien président Jair Bolsonaro, qui est assigné à résidence après avoir été condamné pour avoir tenté de renverser le résultat de l'élection de 2022, perdue face à Lula.
Si aucun candidat n'obtient plus de 50% des suffrages valides lors du premier tour de dimanche, les deux candidats arrivés en tête s'affronteront lors d'un second tour qui aura lieu le 25 octobre.

items.title: Bucs elevate Easton Stick to be backup QB vs. Packers
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers elevated Easton Stick off the practice squad Saturday to be their backup quarterback for Sunday's home game against the Green Bay Packers.
items.body:
The Tampa Bay Buccaneers elevated Easton Stick off the practice squad Saturday to be their backup quarterback for Sunday's home game against the Green Bay Packers.
Stick will serve as the No. 2 quarterback behind Jalon Daniels, an undrafted rookie from Kansas making his first career start. Regular starter Baker Mayfield is sidelined with a dislocated thumb on his throwing hand.
Stick, 31, was signed to the Buccaneers' practice squad on Sept. 1. He has played in six NFL games, all for the Los Angeles Chargers, and passed for 1,133 yards, three touchdowns and one interception.
Stick went 0-4 as a starter for the Chargers in 2023 when Justin Herbert was injured. He was with the Chargers from 2019-24 and was a member of the Atlanta Falcons in 2025.
Tampa Bay signed veteran Brett Rypien to its practice squad on Wednesday to give the club another option while Mayfield is sidelined. Mayfield is expected to miss three games.
Rypien, 30, has played in 11 NFL games (four starts) with the Denver Broncos (2020-22), Los Angeles Rams (2023) and Cincinnati Bengals (2025). He has completed 58.3% of his passes for 950 yards, four touchdowns and nine interceptions.
The Buccaneers also elevated linebacker Caden Fordham from the practice squad to the 53-man roster for Sunday's game. It would be the rookie's first career game if he makes it on the field.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro concluyen sus campañas antes de primera vuelta de elecciones en Brasil
items.author: Lisandra Paraguassu, Sebastian Rocandio
items.creator: Lisandra Paraguassu, Sebastian Rocandio
items.summary: El presidente brasileño, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, y el senador Flávio Bolsonaro concluyeron el sábado sus campañas de cara a la primera vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales del domingo, y ambos se mostraron confiados en la victoria a pesar de que las encuestas apuntaban a un probable balotaje.
items.body:
El presidente brasileño, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, y el senador Flávio Bolsonaro concluyeron el sábado sus campañas de cara a la primera vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales del domingo, y ambos se mostraron confiados en la victoria a pesar de que las encuestas apuntaban a un probable balotaje.
Lula puso fin a su campaña de reelección con una marcha por São Paulo que atrajo a una gran multitud de seguidores, mientras que Bolsonaro participó en una caravana de motocicletas por Santa Bárbara d’Oeste y Americana, en el estado de São Paulo, y posteriormente celebró un mitin en Río de Janeiro.
El equipo de Lula calificó el acto como una afluencia récord, superior a la del mitin de clausura de su campaña de 2022.
Los organizadores afirmaron que unos 150.000 simpatizantes llenaron el tramo de dos kilómetros de la calle Augusta, entre la avenida Paulista y la plaza Roosevelt, un escenario tradicional para las manifestaciones políticas en la ciudad más grande de Brasil.
Desde un vehículo de campaña, Lula calificó las elecciones del domingo como una elección entre "la democracia y la barbarie".
El líder del Partido de los Trabajadores (PT), Edinho Silva, dijo que la participación reflejaba el creciente impulso de Lula.
"A diferencia de otros países latinoamericanos, donde al final se produjo una ola de derecha, aquí en Brasil estamos viendo una ola a nuestro favor", dijo Silva.
El senador de derecha Bolsonaro, en tanto, instó a sus seguidores a acudir a las urnas y pronosticó una victoria en la primera vuelta.
"Estoy convencido de que todo está a nuestro favor para ganar estas elecciones en la primera vuelta", dijo el legislador.
Flávio fue fotografiado sosteniendo una pancarta con la imagen de su padre, el expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, quien se encuentra bajo arresto domiciliario tras haber sido condenado por intentar anular el resultado de las elecciones de 2022, en las que perdió frente a Lula.
Si ningún candidato obtiene más del 50% de los votos válidos, excluidos los votos en blanco y nulos, en la primera vuelta del domingo, los dos postulantes más votados pasarán a un balotaje que se celebrará el 25 de octubre.

items.title: Brazil's Lula, Flavio Bolsonaro wrap up campaigns ahead of first-round vote
items.author: Lisandra Paraguassu, Sebastian Rocandio
items.creator: Lisandra Paraguassu, Sebastian Rocandio
items.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro wrapped up their campaigns on Saturday ahead of Sunday's first-round presidential election, each expressing confidence of victory despite polls pointing to a likely runoff.
items.body:
Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro wrapped up their campaigns on Saturday ahead of Sunday's first-round [USN:L6N45K0PD TEXT:"presidential election"], each expressing confidence of victory despite polls pointing to a [USN:S0N45F00D TEXT:"likely runoff"].
[USN:L6N45K0PD TEXT:"Lula"] ended his re-election campaign with a march through Sao Paulo that drew large crowds of supporters, while [USN:L1N45F0NC TEXT:"Bolsonaro"] took part in a motorcycle caravan through Santa Barbara d'Oeste and Americana in Sao Paulo state and later rallied in Rio de Janeiro.
Lula's camp hailed the event as a record turnout, larger than the closing rally of his 2022 campaign.
Organizers said some 150,000 supporters filled the two-kilometer stretch of Augusta Street between Paulista Avenue and Roosevelt Square, a traditional stage for political demonstrations in Brazil's largest city.
Speaking from a campaign vehicle, Lula called Sunday's election a choice between "democracy and barbarism."
The head of the leftist leader's Workers' Party, Edinho Silva, said the turnout reflected growing momentum for Lula.
"Unlike other Latin American countries, where we saw a right-wing wave at the end, here in Brazil we're seeing a wave in our favor," Silva said.
Right-wing Senator Bolsonaro urged supporters to turn out to vote and predicted a first-round win.
"I am convinced that everything is in place for us to win this election in the first round," the lawmaker said.
Flavio was photographed holding a placard bearing the image of his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest after being convicted of attempting to overturn the 2022 election result, which he lost to Lula.
If no candidate wins more than 50% of valid votes -- which exclude blank and null ballots -- in Sunday's first-round vote, the two frontrunners advance to a second-round runoff on October 25.

items.title: フーシ派、リヤドのアラムコ施設攻撃と発表　サウジの攻撃に報復
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３日　ロイター］ - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は３日、サウジアラビアの首都リヤドにあるサウジアラムコの施設を弾道ミサイルと無人機で攻撃したと発表した。イエメンの首都サヌアやその他の州へのサウジの攻撃に対する報復だとしている。

これに先立ち、リヤドにあるアラムコ施設の近くから大量の煙と炎が上がったとの目撃者情報が出ていた。

アラムコ施設への攻撃について、サウジ当局は今のところ確認していない。アラムコもコメント要請に応じていない。

サウジとフーシ派の衝突は激しさを増し、フーシ派はサウジの都市やエネルギーインフラへの攻撃を強めている。

フーシ派は先週、サウジ西部ヤンブーにあるアラムコの施設をミサイルと無人機で攻撃したと発表した。サウジはその際、フーシ派がタイフとヤンブー周辺に向けて撃った弾道ミサイル６発を撃墜したと説明したが、アラムコ施設の被害については明らかにしなかった。

items.title: Vídeo manipulado simula apoio de Virginia a Flávio Bolsonaro
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Um vídeo manipulado que circula nas redes sociais simula uma declaração de voto da influenciadora Virgínia Fonseca em Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato a presidente pelo PL. Nas imagens originais, Virgínia se defendia de acusações de racismo.
items.body:
Um vídeo manipulado que circula nas redes sociais simula uma declaração de voto da influenciadora Virginia Fonseca em Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato a presidente pelo PL. Nas imagens originais, Virgínia se defendia de acusações de racismo.
Esses são os principais detalhes:
“Virginia Fonseca declara apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro nas eleições de 2026”, dizem os posts , que simulam uma página do g1 e foram compartilhados no Facebook e no Instagram.
Nas imagens checadas, a influenciadora aparece dizendo: “Oi, pessoal. Aqui é a Virginia. Estou aqui hoje para declarar apoio ao Flávio Bolsonaro para presidente nas eleições deste ano”.
O vídeo original não está mais disponível no perfil no Instagram da influenciadora, mas foi publicado em 20 de maio de 2026 -- o cenário e a aparência de Virgínia são idênticos nos dois conteúdos. Sites como o g1 e o UOL reproduziram a gravação na época.
No vídeo, Virginia pediu desculpas e negou acusações de racismo contra o então ex-namorado Vini Jr. após ter publicado um vídeo beijando um macaco. Ela não mencionou Flávio ou as atuais eleições presidenciais no conteúdo.
A Reuters entrou em contato com a assessoria de imprensa da influenciadora, mas não teve retorno até a publicação deste texto.
A reportagem não encontrou pronunciamentos públicos de Virgínia sobre a disputa presidencial. Em 2022, ela publicou uma mensagem no dia da eleição, mas sem declarar seu voto.
O g1 informou nunca ter publicado a falsa reportagem reproduzida nos posts.
Veredicto: Alterado digitalmente. O vídeo original mostra Virginia se desculpando por acusações de racismo, e não declarando apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro.
Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

items.title: Renault invertirá más de 10.000 millones de euros en Francia en vehículos eléctricos y coches asequibles: CEO
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El Grupo Renault invertirá más de 10.000 millones de euros (11.000 millones de dólares) en Francia durante los próximos cinco años en vehículos eléctricos y automóviles más asequibles, dijo el sábado el presidente ejecutivo de la compañía, François Provost.
items.body:
El Grupo Renault (RENA.PA) invertirá más de 10.000 millones de euros (11.000 millones de dólares) en Francia durante los próximos cinco años en vehículos eléctricos y automóviles más asequibles, dijo el sábado el presidente ejecutivo de la compañía, François Provost.
"En los últimos cinco años, hemos invertido 13.000 millones de euros en Francia para transformar por completo nuestra presencia industrial y apostar por la electricidad, y en los próximos cinco años, si el contexto social y político lo permite, volveremos a invertir más de 10.000 millones de euros para seguir impulsando la electricidad y hacer que los automóviles sean más asequibles», dijo Provost en una entrevista en la emisora France Inter.
Los automóviles eléctricos alcanzaron en septiembre un récord del 42% de las matriculaciones de vehículos nuevos en Francia, con una demanda impulsada por el repunte de los precios del combustible desde el inicio de la guerra de Irán.
"La realidad es que, hoy en día, fabricamos en Francia, en las plantas francesas, más vehículos que antes. En 2025, fabricamos 500.000 automóviles en Francia. En 2026, fabricaremos al menos un 25% más gracias al auge de los vehículos eléctricos", dijo.
(1 dólar = 0,8887 euros)

items.body:
La empresa estatal iraquí Oil Tanker Company transportó 2 millones de barriles de crudo iraquí a bordo de un superpetrolero (VLCC) a través del estrecho de Ormuz, en lo que su director general describió el sábado como la primera operación de este tipo de la empresa en décadas.
Este anuncio significa que la compañía está transportando el crudo a través del estrecho en lugar de entregarlo en el puerto de Basora, lo que otorga a la firma estatal de comercialización de petróleo SOMO una mayor flexibilidad a la hora de decidir cómo y dónde vender el crudo.
El director general de la compañía, Ali Qais Abdul Jabbar, dijo en un comunicado que esta medida podría permitir a SOMO aprovechar mejores oportunidades de venta y fijación de precios.
La Compañía Iraquí de Petroleros también está trabajando para adquirir y poseer petroleros especializados con el fin de ampliar su flota y reforzar su capacidad para competir con las empresas navieras regionales, añadió.
Irak ya había obtenido previamente el permiso de Irán para que los petroleros iraquíes transitaran por el estrecho de Ormuz, que Irán ha cerrado de facto durante su conflicto con Estados Unidos.

Harry Kane y Bukayo Saka marcaron dos goles cada uno en la goleada de Inglaterra por 7-0 a Croacia el sábado en Rijeka, mientras que Jude Bellingham marcó un tanto y dio tres asistencias en una exhibición arrolladora de la Liga de Naciones.
Anthony Gordon y el suplente Morgan Rogers también marcaron, mientras Inglaterra arrollaba a una desorganizada defensa croata en su tercer partido del Grupo 3 de la Liga A, disputado en el estadio Rujevica.
Kane celebró su partido internacional 124 con sus goles número 88 y 89 con la selección inglesa, situándose a solo un partido del récord nacional de Peter Shilton.
El capitán igualará el récord si juega contra la República Checa el martes y podría batirlo definitivamente cuando Inglaterra reciba a Croacia en Wembley el 12 de noviembre.
Inglaterra está empatada con España a seis puntos en el grupo, pero los españoles tienen un partido menos y se enfrentaban a la República Checa en Oviedo este mismo sábado.

items.title: Iraq says it transported 2 million barrels of crude through Strait of Hormuz
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Iraq's state-owned Oil Tanker Company transported 2 million barrels of Iraqi crude aboard a very large crude carrier (VLCC) through the Strait of Hormuz, in what its director general described on Saturday as the company's first such operation in decades.
items.body:
Iraq's state-owned Oil Tanker Company transported 2 million barrels of Iraqi crude aboard a very large crude carrier (VLCC) through the Strait of Hormuz, in what its director general described on Saturday as the company's first such operation in decades.
The announcement means the company is transporting the crude through the strait rather than delivering it at the port of Basra, giving state oil marketer SOMO greater flexibility in how and where it sells the crude.
The company's director general, Ali Qais Abdul Jabbar, said in a statement that the move could allow SOMO to take advantage of better sales and pricing opportunities.
Iraq's Oil Tanker Company is also working to buy and own specialized crude oil tankers to expand its fleet and strengthen its ability to compete with regional shipping companies, he added.
Iraq has previously secured Iranian permission for Iraqi oil tankers to transit the Strait of Hormuz, which Iran has effectively closed during its conflict with the US.

items.title: Trump met en ligne le numéro de téléphone d'un sénateur républicain en désaccord avec le changement d'heure
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Le président américain Donald Trump a publié en ligne le numéro de téléphone présumé d'un sénateur républicain américain, dans le cadre d'une polémique entre les deux hommes sur la pérennisation de l'heure d'été.
items.body:
Le président américain Donald Trump a publié en ligne le numéro de téléphone présumé d'un sénateur républicain américain, dans le cadre d'une polémique entre les deux hommes sur la pérennisation de l'heure d'été.
Dans un message publié sur les réseaux sociaux, Donald Trump a exhorté les citoyens à appeler un numéro de téléphone qui, selon lui, appartient au sénateur Tom Cotton, élu républicain de l'Arkansas, qui s'oppose à un projet de loi soutenu par le président américain visant à mettre fin au changement d'heure.
Le différend porte sur le "Sunshine Protection Act", qui prévoit de mettre un terme à la pratique consistant à avancer ou reculer les montres d'une heure deux fois par an.
Selon Donald Trump, la plupart des Américains souhaitent profiter davantage de la lumière du soleil l'après-midi. Mais pour Tom Cotton, ce changement plongera les lève-tôt dans l'obscurité pendant les mois d'hiver.
"À tous les habitants de l'Arkansas : Tom Cotton, un de mes amis, bloque un projet de loi très important", écrit Donald Trump sur sa plateforme Truth Social.
Tom Cotton n'a pas répondu directement à la déclaration du président américain mais a dit ceci sur la plate-forme X :
"Personne n'aime changer d'heure, moi y compris, mais le Congrès a déjà adopté à plusieurs reprises l'heure d'été permanente et l'a abrogée à chaque fois, quand les Américains ont dû faire face à des levers de soleil absurdement tardifs en hiver", écrit-il.
"Les habitants de l'Arkansas ne veulent pas que leurs enfants se rendent à l'école dans l'obscurité totale, et je ferai toujours passer l'Arkansas en premier", ajoute-t-il.
Lorsque Reuters a appelé le numéro fourni par Donald Trump pour joindre Tom Cotton, l'appel a été directement redirigé vers une boîte vocale qui ne s'identifiait pas comme appartenant au sénateur.

items.title: ‘Have no intention of stopping’: Bryan Cranston, 70, on continuing to work
items.summary: Speaking to PEOPLE while attending ArtPrize, an annual art competition and cultural festival in Grand Rapids, Michigan, Cranston said he wants to continue working for as long as he can.
items.body:
‘Have no intention of stopping’: Bryan Cranston, 70, on continuing to work Speaking to PEOPLE while attending ArtPrize, an annual art competition and cultural festival in Grand Rapids, Michigan, Cranston said he wants to continue working for as long as he can.
ANI | Updated: 04-10-2026 08:50 IST | Created: 04-10-2026 08:50 IST

Bryan Cranston (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Actor Bryan Cranston has no plans to slow down his work anytime soon. The 70-year-old actor, known for shows such as Breaking Bad and Malcolm in the Middle, said he cannot imagine retiring from acting and writing. Speaking to PEOPLE while attending ArtPrize, an annual art competition and cultural festival in Grand Rapids, Michigan, Cranston said he wants to continue working for as long as he can.
“For an actor living the life that I am very fortunate to have, I have no intention of stopping, and I think life will stop before I will want it to, and that will be great,” Cranston said. The actor added that retirement is not something he sees himself choosing, saying that acting and writing are a major part of his life.
“It’s like stopping breathing for me. If I stopped acting and writing, what would I do? I’m not one that’s going to sit on the porch, just because I’m of that age,” continues the actor. “Some people cannot wait for retirement, but I wouldn’t know what to do with it.” Cranston also spoke about how he wants to look back on his life when the time comes. He said he hopes to have lived and worked enough to feel that he has nothing left to give.
“Someone once said, ‘When all is said and done, and it’s time for me to leave the earth, I want to be completely worn out,’ and I think that’s a good way to [go],” adds Cranston. “I want to be absolutely completely worn out, like, I got nothing left.” “I did everything, I traveled, I experienced life, and I’m tired and I’m just absolutely done,” he further explains. “I want to be able to be proud of the things that I’ve [accomplished].”
Cranston comes from a family with a long connection to acting. His parents, Joseph Louis Cranston and Annalisa “Peggy” Cranston, were actors, and he is part of a family that has four generations of actors. His daughter, Taylor Dearden, has also earned praise for her role as Dr. Melissa “Mel” King in The Pitt. The actor has played several well-known characters during his career, including Walter White in Breaking Bad and Hal in Malcolm in the Middle. He has also appeared in films such as Trumbo and Argo and worked in theatre in productions including All the Way, Network and All My Sons.
Cranston has also worked as a writer, producer and director. His career has earned him several Emmy and Tony Awards, along with a Laurence Olivier Award and a Golden Globe Award. He has also received nominations for an Academy Award and a British Academy Film Award. Looking back at how his interest in acting began, Cranston recalled growing up around his actor parents. He said watching them work eventually led him to try performing himself.
“[My siblings and I], we were watching our parents do things like, my dad’s doing a movie here, my mom’s doing a commercial there, and the first play I ever did was in our garage. My brother wrote and directed it, so he was my very first director,” the actor says. “I think we charged the neighbor kids a nickel to come see it, and that included a glass of punch or something,” he continues with a laugh.
“So once you get that sense of performing, even if it’s a garage production of something, once you do that, it either ignites something, or you never want to do that again,” Cranston adds. “Or sometimes it’s like, ‘Well, that was fun. I’m glad I did it, but I don’t need to do it anymore.’" (ANI)

items.title: White Sox gain ALDS edge with Munetaka Murakami HR, shutout pitching
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: CLEVELAND -- Munetaka Murakami belted a two-run homer off All-Star Parker Messick and five pitchers combined on a three-hitter as the Chicago White Sox beat the Cleveland Guardians 3-0 in Game 1 of the American League Division Series on Saturday afternoon.
items.body:
CLEVELAND -- Munetaka Murakami belted a two-run homer off All-Star Parker Messick and five pitchers combined on a three-hitter as the Chicago White Sox beat the Cleveland Guardians 3-0 in Game 1 of the American League Division Series on Saturday afternoon.
Murakami, a 26-year-old rookie from Japan, hammered a 440-foot shot to right field off Messick in the fourth inning. His first postseason homer -- and 36th overall this year -- plated Miguel Vargas to put the White Sox up 2-0.
"I was ready, this was the moment I was preparing for the entire season," said Murakami, who yelled toward the visiting dugout as his homer cleared the fence. "I can't explain what I said in words (to the team), but it was a little bit dirty."
Chicago extended its lead to 3-0 in the seventh when Colson Montgomery doubled just inside third base against Erik Sabrowski, bringing home Kyle Teel. The White Sox have won three consecutive games to begin their postseason.
Bryan Hudson retired the only batter he faced in the third inning for the victory, and closer Grant Taylor tossed the final four innings for the save. Taylor struck out six and allowed a pair of hits.
Game 2 of the best-of-five series is Monday afternoon in Cleveland. The White Sox have won eight of the 14 contests between the teams this season, splitting eight games at Progressive Field, the home of the AL Central champion Guardians.
"The first game in the series is very important. Now, we'll get the one day (of) rest and focus on winning again," Murakami said.
"I can't speak English too much, so the one thing I know is 'Let's go,' and that's it," he added.
Messick, a rookie making his postseason debut, struck out six over 4 1/3 innings and allowed two runs on four hits and two walks. The left-hander threw 87 pitches before being replaced by Daniel Espino.
Cleveland was held hitless until the fourth, when Travis Bazzana doubled with two outs against Anthony Kay. The Guardians would load the bases with two out for the second straight inning, but Brayan Rocchio lined out to right.
"Of course, you're frustrated when you get shut out," Guardians manager Stephen Vogt said. "We just couldn't get it going early in the inning to get some action going. But we didn't get down."
White Sox rookie Hagen Smith worked as an opener for the second time this week, tossing 2 2/3 scoreless innings. The left-hander did not give up a hit, struck out four and walked three.
Smith retired the first eight Cleveland batters before walking Rocchio, Steven Kwan and Jose Ramirez in the third, prompting White Sox manager Will Venable to lift him for Hudson. The 6-foot-8 left-hander retired lefty-swinging Chase DeLauter on a fly to left to end the inning.
Jordan Hicks followed Hudson and recorded two outs before Kay entered.
The Guardians' Jo Adell struck out four times in four plate appearances in the first playoff game of his seven-year career. He was acquired from the Los Angeles Angels at the trade deadline.
"I was definitely in a blender today, getting different looks every time up from a different pitcher," Adell said. "We've got to adjust because we were trying to find it all day. Postseason is a pitcher's duel and we've got to bounce back."
Chicago catcher Teel was unsuccessful on his first ABS challenge after going 5-for-5 in the wild-card round.
--Brian Dulik, Field Level Media

items.title: Report: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) to miss multiple games
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Philadelphia Eagles wide receiver DeVonta Smith is expected to miss multiple games with a hamstring injury, The Philadelphia Inquirer reported Saturday.
items.body:
Philadelphia Eagles wide receiver DeVonta Smith is expected to miss multiple games with a hamstring injury, The Philadelphia Inquirer reported Saturday.
The 27-year-old Smith missed time in training camp due to the injury, but he was able to suit up for the first three games of the season, reeling in 19 receptions for 235 yards and a touchdown. He did not participate in practice this week, however, as he dealt with the injury once again, and the Eagles listed him as out for their Week 4 home contest Sunday against the Los Angeles Rams.
The Inquirer reported that Smith could miss two to three games with the injury.
With Marquise Brown already sidelined by an ankle injury, Dontayvion Wicks is expected to serve as the team's top receiver against the Rams.
Smith recorded 77 receptions for 1,008 yards and four touchdowns last season. He has topped 800 receiving yards in each of his first five NFL seasons, including three campaigns with 1,000 or more receiving yards.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Pistons announce contract extension for C Jalen Duren
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Detroit Pistons officially announced the contract extension involving All-NBA center Jalen Duren on Saturday.
items.body:
The Detroit Pistons officially announced the contract extension involving All-NBA center Jalen Duren on Saturday.
The team did not divulge terms of the deal, however ESPN and The Athletic previously reported it was a five-year, $200 million contract.
Duren, 22, had been a restricted free agent.
"We're excited to have Jalen in Detroit as a core piece of our team for years to come," said Trajan Langdon, the Pistons' president of basketball operations. "He's been an important part of our success over the last two seasons, and we've seen tremendous growth in his game. Jalen has accomplished a great deal at a young age, and we believe his best basketball is still ahead of him. We're proud of the work he's put in and look forward to his continued growth and impact on our team."
The first-time All-Star and third-team All-NBA player saw his numbers sag to 10.2 points and 8.5 rebounds per playoff game. That came on the heels of his averaging a career-high 19.5 points with 10.5 rebounds over a regular season that resulted in the Pistons finishing with the Eastern Conference's top record at 60-22.
Detroit lost in the Eastern Conference semifinals in seven games to the Cleveland Cavaliers.
The organization reportedly offered Duren the same $200 million deal in recent days, but with the addition of a weight clause. The new agreement reportedly removed that clause.
Pistons coach J.B. Bickerstaff that he didn't sense any bitterness from Duren toward his teammates or the organization when he met with the team on Friday.
"I don't know where that came from. It's negotiation, it's business, but there's never been any bitterness between the group and how we feel about him and I know how he feels about us," Bickerstaff said.
A first-round choice (13th overall) in the 2022 draft, Duren has played his entire four-year career in Detroit.
He has career averages of 13.5 points, 10.3 rebounds and 2.1 assists.
--Field Level Media

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Iran's rial continued its decline on Saturday, as the central bank announced an injection of up to $2 billion to support the currency while the economy faces US sanctions and a naval blockade.
items.body:
Iran's rial continued its decline on Saturday, as the central bank announced an injection of up to $2 billion to support the currency while the economy faces US sanctions and a naval blockade.
The US dollar was sold around 2.688 million rials, up from 2.632 million on Friday, according to free-market tracking website bon-bast.com, while alanchand.com reported 2.695 million rials per dollar.
State television said state banks began selling up to $2 billion to support the currency, which has lost more than half of its value in the past year.
With an inflation rate of more than 70%, [USN:L6N45K0UX TEXT:"life"] is becoming ever tougher for ordinary citizens unable to afford basic necessities or rent as a US blockade cuts the state's financial lifeline – oil exports.
Many Iranians seeking safe havens for their savings have been buying dollars, other hard currencies or gold.
Mehdi Darabi, an aide to the central bank's governor on foreign exchange affairs, blamed the decline of the rial partly on what he said were false predictions by US officials of the collapse of the Iranian economy.
"It is suggested that the Iranian economy is about to crash... The enemy is using this to affect the exchange rate of our currency," Darabi told state TV, adding that the current fall of the rial was temporary.

items.title: Le rial iranien tombe à un nouveau plus bas, la banque centrale intervient
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Le rial iranien a poursuivi sa chute samedi, conduisant la banque centrale du pays à annoncer une intervention pouvant atteindre deux milliards de dollars (1,78 milliard d'euros) pour soutenir la monnaie.
items.body:
Le rial iranien a poursuivi sa chute samedi, conduisant la banque centrale du pays à annoncer une intervention pouvant atteindre deux milliards de dollars (1,78 milliard d'euros) pour soutenir la monnaie.
L'Iran, attaqué par les Etats-Unis et Israël le 28 février, est confronté à des sanctions américaines pesant sur son économie et à un blocus naval imposé par l'US Navy.
Le dollar américain s'échangeait à environ 2,688 millions de rials, contre 2,632 millions vendredi, selon le site web bon-bast.com, tandis qu'alanchand.com fait état d'un taux de 2,695 millions de rials pour un dollar.
Selon la télévision d'État, les banques publiques ont commencé à vendre jusqu'à deux milliards de dollars pour soutenir la monnaie, qui a perdu plus de la moitié de sa valeur au cours de l'année écoulée.
Avec un taux d'inflation supérieur à 70%, les citoyens ordinaires sont confrontés à des difficultés croissantes, incapables de subvenir à leurs besoins essentiels ou de payer leur loyer.
Le blocus américain ampute la principale source de revenus de l'État iraniens : les exportations de pétrole.
De nombreux Iraniens, dans une volonté de préserver leur épargne, ont acheté des dollars, d'autres devises fortes ou de l'or.
Mehdi Darabi, conseiller du gouverneur de la banque centrale chargé des affaires de change, attribue la chute du rial en partie à ce qu'il a qualifié de fausses prédictions des responsables américains concernant l'effondrement de l'économie iranienne.
"On laisse entendre que l'économie iranienne est sur le point de s'effondrer (...) L'ennemi s'en sert pour influencer le taux de change de notre monnaie", a-t-il dit à la télévision d’État, assurant que la chute actuelle du rial était temporaire.

Yemen's internationally recognised government on Saturday (local time) confirmed strikes against what it described as "vital targets" of the Houthis in Sanaa and Saada, after the rebel group claimed it carried out a missile and drone operation targeting Aramco facilities in Saudi Arabia's capital, Riyadh. The developments mark a fresh escalation in the ongoing conflict, with both sides issuing statements claiming military actions.
In a statement issued by the media centre of the Armed Forces of Yemen's internationally recognised government, the official spokesperson said Yemeni forces were carrying out strikes against Houthi-controlled areas. "We are delivering painful strikes against vital targets of the terrorist Houthi militia in Sanaa and Saada," the official spokesperson said.
The spokesperson further warned that Houthi military capabilities would remain under attack. "The capabilities of the Houthi militia will not be safe from the fire of our armed forces, and we will destroy them," the spokesperson added.
The statement came after the Houthi group said it had launched a military operation targeting Aramco in Riyadh using ballistic missiles and drones. According to a statement issued by Houthi military spokesperson Brigadier General Yahya Saree, the attack was carried out in response to what the group described as Saudi strikes against Sanaa and other areas under its control.
"In response to the Saudi aggression against the capital, Sana'a, and the liberated provinces, which in the past 24 hours reached up to 60 airstrikes and missile attacks, bringing the total number of Saudi aggression attacks since the escalation against our country to 1,410," the Houthi statement said. The Houthi group said that it carried out a "qualitative military operation" using ballistic missiles and drones against Aramco facilities in Riyadh.
The group claimed that the operation achieved its objective and said fires broke out at the targeted sites. "The operation successfully achieved its objective, thanks to Allah," the statement said.
"The strikes were precise and direct, resulting in fire breaking out at the targeted sites," it added. The Houthi statement also warned of further escalation, saying the group would respond to what it described as attacks against Yemen and its people.
"The shedding of Yemeni blood with such criminality and brutality necessitates that the armed forces, along with all the free people of our nation, take all necessary escalatory steps and deterrent measures to affirm to everyone that the price for disregarding the blood of our faithful people will be high and exorbitant, and the criminal enemy must understand that continuing to shed our people's blood will cost them dearly," the statement said. The group further said it would continue its policy of escalation until the attacks and blockade against Yemen end.
"We will continue to impose the equation of "a siege for a siege", and "an escalation for escalation", and targeting the Saudi enemy's troop buildups until the aggression ceases and the siege on our beloved country is lifted," the statement said. The latest exchange of strikes comes amid continuing tensions involving Yemen's internationally recognised government, the Houthi group and Saudi Arabia, with both sides accusing the other of escalating military action. items.title: Panthers place captain Aleksander Barkov on long-term IR
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Florida Panthers placed captain Aleksander Barkov on long-term injured reserve Saturday.
items.body:
The Florida Panthers placed captain Aleksander Barkov on long-term injured reserve Saturday.
The move means Barkov will be sidelined at least the next 10 games as he nurses a left leg injury.
ESPN reported the Panthers remain optimistic that Barkov's injury is not season-ending.
Barkov was injured during the second period of Florida's 4-3 overtime loss to the San Jose Sharks on Thursday. He was vying for the puck along the boards when he was pushed by Sharks defenseman Darnell Nurse, causing Barkov to fall to the ice with his knee in an awkward angle.
Barkov remained on the ice for several moments before retreating to the locker room.
He was playing in his second game this season after missing the entire 2025-26 campaign due to torn ligaments in his right knee.
Barkov, 31, is a two-time Stanley Cup winner and a three-time Selke Trophy recipient (2021, 2024, 2025) as the NHL's best defensive forward.
He boasts franchise records for goals (286), assists (496), points (782) and games played (806) since being selected with the second overall pick of the 2013 NHL Draft.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Não há evidências de que governo discuta "lei Janja" para taxar igrejas e financiar umbanda
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Não há evidências de que exista um projeto de lei apelidado de "lei Janja", em referência à primeira-dama Janja Lula da Silva, que taxaria igrejas evangélicas e usaria os recursos resultantes para financiar a criação de terreiros de umbanda, como afirmam publicações nas redes sociais.
items.body:
Não há evidências de que exista um projeto de lei apelidado de "lei Janja", em referência à primeira-dama Janja Lula da Silva, que taxaria igrejas evangélicas e usaria os recursos resultantes para financiar a criação de terreiros de umbanda, como afirmam publicações nas redes sociais.
"Lei Janja pretende taxar igrejas evangélicas para financiar novos terreiros de umbanda em prol da pluralidade religiosa", dizem os posts , que circulam no Facebook, no Instagram e no Threads. As publicações afirmam que o governo federal discute a proposta.
A Secretaria de Comunicação Social da Presidência da República afirmou que o conteúdo é falso. "Não houve nenhuma medida nesse sentido como também não há nenhuma proposta com esse escopo em discussão", disse em nota .
A assessoria da primeira-dama também afirmou que o conteúdo não é verídico e que não há nenhuma proposta de lei com o nome dela.
Não consta nenhuma norma semelhante à mencionada nos posts no Portal da Legislação , que lista as leis sancionadas no país, ou nos sites da Câmara dos Deputados e do Senado .
A Constituição Federal de 1988 garante a isenção tributária de entidades religiosas.
As publicações circulam após rumores de que o candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) pretendia destituir Nossa Senhora Aparecida do título de padroeira do Brasil caso eleito, o que ele nega.
Desde então, a Reuters verificou conteúdos desinformativos ligados a questões religiosas e à campanha eleitoral.
VEREDICTO Sem evidências. Não há qualquer registro de que o governo federal discuta um projeto de lei que visa taxar igrejas evangélicas para financiar terreiros de umbanda.
Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

items.title: Lettonie La " Liste unie" du Premier ministre largement en tête des élections
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La " Liste unie", formation centriste et pro-ukrainienne du Premier ministre letton Andris Kulbergs, semble en passe de signer une plus large victoire que prévu au scrutin législatif organisé samedi, les électeurs ayant ainsi exprimé leur inquiétude par rapport à une possible agression russe.
items.body:
La " Liste unie", formation centriste et pro-ukrainienne du Premier ministre letton Andris Kulbergs, semble en passe de signer une plus large victoire que prévu au scrutin législatif organisé samedi, les électeurs ayant ainsi exprimé leur inquiétude par rapport à une possible agression russe.
Le sondage à la sortie des urnes réalisé par la chaîne publique lettone LSM montre ainsi que la "Liste unie" a remporté 35,6% des voix, devant le parti populiste "Lettonie d’abord", qui s'inspire du mouvement "Maga" du président américain Donald Trump, avec 11,3% des suffrages.
"Lettonie d'abord" avait notamment courtisé l'importante minorité ethnique russe de la Lettonie à l'approche du scrutin.
Vers la mi-juillet, les présidents lituanien et letton, Gitanas Nauseda et Edgars Rinkevics, ont [USN:L8N43H0SI TEXT:"accusé"] la Russie de projets de sabotage contre des pays de l'Otan, accusations qualifiées par Moscou de "fables alarmistes".
Au début de même mois, la Pologne avait dit que les services de renseignement occidentaux s'inquiétaient du risque d'attaques russes contre son territoire et les États baltes. Moscou dément régulièrement ce type d'accusations qui s'inscrivent selon elles dans le cadre d'une campagne de propagande antirusse.
Il y a quelques jours, l'Estonie a dit être parvenue à la conclusion qu'un [USN:L8N45L0XL TEXT:"incendie"] ayant eu lieu en août dans les locaux de la société de défense Milrem Robotics, fournisseur de drones terrestres pour l'Ukraine, était un acte criminel commandité par les services de sécurité russes.
NÉCESSITÉ DE TROUVER UN ALLIÉ POUR GOUVERNER Réagissant aux résultats des sondages à la sortie des urnes, Andris Kulbergs a déclaré qu’il espérait rester Premier ministre, ajoutant qu'il ne souhaitait pas gouverner avec "Lettonie d'abord".
Si les sondages à la sortie des urnes sont confirmés par les résultats officiels, le Premier ministre aura besoin d'alliés pour être en mesure de former un gouvernement.
"C'est remarquablement bon. Je ne m'attendais pas à un tel résultat", s'est félicité Andeis Kulbergs au siège de son parti à Riga.
Le parti des Progressistes arrive en troisième position dans le classement des sondages à la sortie des urnes, avec également 11,3%, suivi du parti ouvertement pro-russe "Sovereign Power", avec 10,8%.
Outre les questions de sécurité, celle du coût de la vie a également dominé la campagne électorale en Lettonie, État membre de l'Otan et de l'Union européenne qui partage une frontière avec la Russie et abrite une importante minorité russophone.
Andris Kulbergs, homme d’affaires et pilote de rallye amateur de 47 ans, est arrivé au pouvoir en mai après l'effondrement de la [USN:L6N41R0M0 TEXT:"coalition précédente"], en raison de la façon dont cette dernière avait géré des incidents au cours desquels des drones militaires avaient pénétré dans l'espace aérien letton sans être détectés.
Tout au long de sa campagne, il a promis de renforcer les capacités anti-drones de la Lettonie et de maintenir les dépenses de défense à 5% du produit intérieur brut, l'un des niveaux les plus élevés de l'OTAN.
La Lettonie, qui compte 1,9 million d'habitants, longe la mer Baltique, avec au nord et au sud l'Estonie et la Lituanie, alliées de l'UE et de l'Otan, et à l'est la Russie et la Biélorussie.
